caption: The drawing depicts a single handled bowl or pot with three short legs. The main object is rendered in an overhead, three-quarters view and is colored brown on the outside and off-white or cream on the inside. The handle is elongated, rounded, and attached to one side of the bowl, and there are three small round legs providing support at the base. A smaller, simplified side view of the same bowl appears below the main illustration inside a light rectangular frame, showing the profile of the pot and its legs. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige or off-white color, and there is sectioned text indicating "3/4 Scale" near the main object and "1/5 Substyle" near the smaller view. The composition is centered with ample empty space around the depicted objects.
title: Server Dish
